memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: reports mild epigastric burning after meals, able to work full day, no limitation in ADLs. cognition: Mini-Cog 5/5, intact. falls: none in last 12 months, gait normal, TUG 9 seconds (low risk). medicines: 3 regular (pantoprazole, antacid gel SOS, domperidone). mood: denies depression or anxiety. carers: wife Priya, spouse. goals: "I want to stay symptom‑free and continue my office work without discomfort."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
pantoprazole 40 mg tablet, take orally once daily before breakfast.
antacid gel 10 mL, take orally as needed after meals or when heartburn occurs.
domperidone 10 mg tablet, take orally twice daily before breakfast and dinner.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have noticed my heartburn is less frequent now, about twice a week, and it is milder. I still use the antacid gel occasionally after spicy meals. The domperidone seems to help with bloating after dinner.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy performed. Findings: Mild erythema of the antrum, no ulceration or erosions. Biopsy taken for histology and H. pylori culture. Conclusion: No significant mucosal injury; mild gastritis suggestive of reflux-related changes.
